issues.title: Four hidden FFX chapters ask the host for a voice manifest that does not exist: a 404 and a console error each time one starts
issues.detail: voice.beginChapter fetches audio/voice/<chapter>.json for every FFX chapter; the 12 board chapters have one (200), the hidden biran-yenke (word gagazet), sinspawn-gui (mushroom), exp-fayth (fayth) and last-summoning (summon) do not, and Cloudflare answers 404 (the browser logs 'Failed to load resource ... 404'). The miss is handled (the chapter plays text-only, nothing a player sees changes). Seen live in 4 smoke contexts and the harness context, and by a probe of all five doors. A local server that answers an unknown path with index.html would read 200 and hide it, which is what CHK-017 exists for.
issues.game: FFX only (the voice is FFX only; FFX-2 asks for nothing: 0 voice requests in the Bahamut runs)
issues.suggestion: have the director consult the chapter list already in audio/voice/index.json before asking, or ship empty manifests for the four hidden chapters; not applied (a live review changes nothing)
